title: Protective Mandates & Legal Aims
goal: State institutional mandates and legal aims with formal purpose connectors

items: I can use formal purpose connectors with que + subjunctive (a fin de que, con el objeto de que, con el fin de que) when subjects differ.
I can choose between the infinitive (same subject) and que + subjunctive (different subjects) in institutional mandates.
I can use safeguard, ombudsman, and access-to-justice vocabulary in C1 prose.
